process.title: Your Journey With Us

steps.label: Step 1
steps.title: Book a Free Call
steps.description: Tell us what you're looking for. We'll walk you through the market, answer every question honestly, and figure out if we're the right fit. Zero cost, zero pressure, zero commitment.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.title: We Go to Work
steps.description: A one-time Client Representation Fee that puts us fully on your side, not the seller's. Here's what it covers:
bullets: Full market scan, not just our own listings
Architectural quality assessment on every shortlisted property
Video-documented inspections you can review from anywhere
In-person guidance at every property visit
Fideicomiso (bank trust) coordination, your legal path to ownership in Mexico
Full closing coordination with the Notary and your legal team

steps.label: Step 3
steps.title: Closing Assistance
steps.description: Found the one? We guide you through every step of the closing process so you don't have to navigate Mexican bureaucracy alone. Here's what to expect:
bullets: You sign a purchase agreement and place a deposit (typically 10-30%)
A government-appointed Notary Public verifies the title, checks for liens, and drafts your deed
For coastal properties, we coordinate the setup of your Fideicomiso, a renewable 50-year bank trust that gives you full ownership rights
Closing costs typically run 4-7% (acquisition tax, notary fees, trust setup, registry)
The full process takes one to four months. We coordinate with all parties, track every deadline, and keep you informed along the way

steps.label: Step 4
steps.title: You Get the Keys
steps.description: Move into a property that's been checked from foundation to rooftop. We're with you through every stage. The legal outcome is handled by the Notary and the authorities, but you'll never face any of it alone.

process.fideicomisoNote: What is a Fideicomiso? Mexican law requires foreigners buying near the coast to hold property through a bank trust. A Mexican bank holds the title on your behalf, but you keep all the rights: you can live in it, rent it out, renovate, sell, or pass it on to your heirs. The trust renews every 50 years and costs roughly $500 to $1,000 USD per year. Thousands of international buyers use this exact structure to own property safely across Mexico. We take care of the entire setup for you.
process.note: Our service focuses on properties starting at 250,000 USD.
